rows.indian_institute_of_technology_indore_ii: Fellowship Rs. 61,000 + HRA (as per project norms)
Sirpur and Yashwant Sagar Wetland, Indore, M.P.
Ph.D. in Environmental Engineering/ Civil Engineering/ Biotechnology/ Geosciences or allied fields, with minimum 1-3 years of relevant post-Ph.D. research experience in microbiology, water monitoring

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IIT Indore notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Ph.D. in Environmental Engineering/ Civil Engineering/ Biotechnology/ Geosciences or allied fields Experience: Minimum 1-3 years of relevant post-Ph.D. research experience in microbiology, water monitoring and supported by evidence of handling research projects independently, publications, laboratory investigations Other conditions: Evidence of handling research projects independently, publications and laboratory investigations is required with the experience Desirable: At least one research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal in water/environment or relevant fields Working experience with extensive field surveys and data analysis through spreadsheets, report writing, and presentation preparation

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: HRA as per project norms. Initial appointment will be for 6 months Fellowship may be terminated with a 30-day notice before completion of the tenure if performance to date is not deemed satisfactory Appointment governed by the terms and conditions of the Institute/ funding agency applicable to the project Selected candidate must join duty immediately upon receipt of the offer

content_sections.heading: How Will IIT Indore Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applicants Online interview (Google Meet) Shortlisted candidates attend an interview on 30-11-2026 at 11:00 AM in online mode only Google Meet links shared only with shortlisted candidates before the interview date Selection committee may restrict the number of candidates called after considering qualifications and experience over and above the minimum Decision of the selection committee is final

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Get the application form: Online application form at https://forms.gle/Ruy68SZLmSQZmLoJ7. Fill in the form and attach self-attested copies of your certificates. Apply on or before 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be provided for the interview Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email for an interview PI not responsible for email delay or non-receipt of the document at the specified time, which will result in disqualification/rejection of the application
